# Tooltip, InfoButton

A near-black bubble with white 12px text, up to 190px wide, with a small arrow. It opens above its trigger on hover and on keyboard focus, and is linked with aria-describedby so screen readers read it.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/tooltip-infobutton)

## Usage

```tsx
<Tooltip content="We use this to send your order confirmation and updates">
  <InfoButton label="More information" />
</Tooltip>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Tooltip content` | `ReactNode` | The bubble’s text. |
| `Tooltip children` | `ReactElement` | One focusable element. It receives aria-describedby. |
| `InfoButton label` | `string` | Accessible name of the round button. |
| `InfoButton icon` | `ReactNode` | Replaces the question mark. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Tooltip.module.css`
- `Tooltip.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
